verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is documented as a native CI/CD system compatible with GitHub Actions YAML workflows, which by design runs on self-hosted runners since Gitea itself is self-hosted (gitea-docs-2). However, the evidence pack lacks explicit runner registration/configuration details, and community reports show long-time Gitea users relying on external CI tools like Drone rather than native Actions (gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-14), suggesting the built-in CI/CD runner feature is newer/less proven in practice. missing for 10: explicit runner setup/registration docs, hands-on confirmation of self-hosted runner reliability, independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
